title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover a variety of focused environments across Bethel's lakeside campus, from quiet library carrels to collaborative lounges and scenic common areas.

cards.title: Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Hagstrom Center, Level 3
cards.notes: Reserve a room for up to 3 hours daily. These spaces feature large whiteboards and power outlets, ideal for collaborative projects or focused group sessions.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms equipped with whiteboards and power outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Rooms can be reserved for up to 3 hours per day; Bethel ID is required at all study room check-ins.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; reservation required via LibCal with a Bethel email address.

cards.title: Royal Grounds Coffee Shop
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons, Level 2
cards.notes: Study with the smell of Caribou Coffee in the air. This central hub offers a mix of tables and soft seating for casual academic work and social breaks.
cards.short_summary: A lively campus coffee shop serving Caribou Coffee with ample seating for casual studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal Grounds is open for most of the day, making it the perfect place to take a study break.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-10:30 p.m.; Friday 7:30 a.m.-7:00 p.m. Closed during Chapel.

cards.title: Dining Center Balcony
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons, Level 4
cards.notes: Head to the balcony level for a quieter atmosphere than the main floor. It provides a spacious area to spread out books between meals.
cards.short_summary: A quieter upper-level seating area within the main dining hall suitable for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monson Dining Center gives students room to spread out between the main floor and the quieter balcony level.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during dining center operating hours; typically requires a meal plan or purchase for entry during meal times.

cards.title: Anderson Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: 2 Pine Tree Drive
cards.notes: Located five minutes from the main campus, these spaces offer soft seating, flexible workstations, and natural light for a non-corporate study feel.
cards.short_summary: Modern community spaces with flexible workstations and natural light at the Anderson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: In the open community spaces are clusters of soft seating, flexible work stations, and charging stands.
cards.source_title: A New Home for Bethel Seminary
cards.access_notes: Open to students; features free Wi-Fi and plentiful parking.

cards.title: RC Third Level Seating
cards.subtitle: Robertson Center, Level 3
cards.notes: This updated corridor features new seating and lighting, providing a convenient spot for quick study sessions between classes in the RC and HC.
cards.short_summary: A recently renovated corridor with dedicated seating for students between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The third level corridor of the RC has been updated with new paint, carpet, ceiling, lighting, and seating.
cards.source_title: Summer Construction Brings a Fresh Look to Bethel Drive
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during academic building hours.

cards.title: Nelson Hall Study Area
cards.subtitle: Nelson Hall, Level 1
cards.notes: A renovated space for freshman residents featuring soft seating and a dedicated study area that opens into a large community lounge with a fireplace.
cards.short_summary: A modern community lounge and study area within Bethel's largest freshman residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: A brand new shack and study area also open into the lounge space, making it feel much larger.
cards.source_title: Summer Construction Brings Renewal to Favorite Spaces
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents of Nelson Hall; accessible via student ID.

cards.title: Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Hagstrom Center, Level 3
cards.notes: Available for independent use, this space supports creative projects and non-traditional study with staff and student advisors available for help.
cards.short_summary: A creative space within the library for independent project work and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Makerspace is available for independent use during library hours.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; check for specific advisor availability.

cards.title: Individual Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Bowen Library Building
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner among the book stacks. These individual carrels are perfect for deep focus and long-form writing without distractions.
cards.short_summary: Quiet individual study desks located within the library's book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The building consists of book stacks and various individual study carrels and lounge area.
cards.access_notes: Available on a first-come, first-served basis during library hours.

cards.title: Wellness Center Lounge
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center, Level 2
cards.notes: Located between the RC and HC, this area offers a bright environment for students to work before or after a workout session.
cards.short_summary: A bright lounge area within the Wellness Center for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Stop by the Wellness Center at WLC200 on the second level between the Hagstrom Center (HC) and Robertson Center (RC).
cards.access_notes: Open during Wellness Center hours; closed for Chapel on MWF 10:10-11 a.m.

cards.title: Niche Departmental Lounges
cards.subtitle: Various Academic Buildings
cards.notes: Over half of Bethel's 18 departments have dedicated lounges. These spaces offer a unique environment to study in proximity to professors and peers.
cards.short_summary: Specialized study and social spaces maintained by individual academic departments.
cards.evidence_claim: Out of the 18 departments on campus, more than half have a space of their own to provide homework space.
cards.source_title: Bethel's not-so-secret student spaces - The Clarion
cards.access_notes: Access varies; some are open to all, while others require major-specific keypad codes.
